capabilities: List converted books in a library
disambiguation: Not a general PDF annotation tool; it extracts text into one Markdown note and rejects scanned image-only PDFs.
extras: Early first public release; tested on only a handful of EPUBs/PDFs and one synthetic Calibre file. MOBI/AZW3/FB2/DOCX conversion is desktop-only and needs a local Calibre install; scanned PDFs are rejected (no OCR). Illustrations as text art are off by default. Manual install or BRAT only.
intentEvidence: If the sibling plugin Brailliant is conceptually its cousin (images → text), Feathershelf is the same idea applied to whole books.
motivation: The author wanted books reduced to just the words so the result stays readable, searchable and genuinely light.
problem: EPUB and PDF books are heavy binary containers that cannot be grepped, diffed or opened in a plain text editor.

relations.evidence: If the sibling plugin Brailliant is conceptually its cousin (images → text), Feathershelf is the same idea applied to whole books.

summary: Book converter that turns EPUB/PDF files into a single plain-text Markdown note with reading progress, table of contents, font zoom and comments.
